integrity: The two-dimensional result follows from an exact closed comparison of the original and equilibrated eigenvalue ratios. The three-dimensional counterfamily is a rank-one SPD update with an explicit symmetry reduction of the equilibrated spectrum. A standalone checker replays exact rational identities and selected numerical consequences but is not used as a substitute for the universal proof.
scientific_limitations: The universal non-worsening theorem is only for dimensions at most two and symmetric Jacobi equilibration of real SPD matrices in the spectral 2-norm. The three-dimensional family proves failure for every nontrivial condition number but does not maximize the possible deterioration at fixed condition number; its asymptotic factor 4/3 is family-specific.
title: Three dimensions are minimal for Jacobi equilibration to worsen SPD conditioning
